anchor.statement: Proposition 4.10. Fix the outer-profile data of Lemma 4.8 and any prescribed finite collection of η -derivative orders. One can choose finite axis parameters j 0 , δ∗ , σ∗ , Λ , a logarithmic transition length T sh , and an amplitude threshold C 0 such that every C ≥ C 0 admits the following construction. Set X a = 4/ Λ , X R = 110(CP ∗ ) 10 , x = X/X R , X h = X R e −5 , f = (1 + η 2 ) −1 . After C, choose a positive activation width t 1 in the logarithmic coordinate log(X/X a ), a positive shear factor κ 0 , and the remaining transition widths. There are profiles E = √ 2X ϕ /C, U, and Π = Π 0 + C p on [0, X h ] × [−1, 1] with these properties. (i) The scalar ϕ is positive, and ϕ , U, Π , V 0 /X are smooth on [0, X h ] × [−1, 1], including X = 0. Thus Equations (4.4) to (4.5) give a smooth Cartesian velocity and pressure across the axis. For some X an ∈ (X a , X h ), these scalars and every fixed radial derivative are analytic in η on one common complex neighborhood throughout [0, X an ] × [−1, 1]. The profiles solve (4.13) for 0 ≤ X ≤ X a , and T 0 = 0 there.

correspondence.by: Christian Garry (drafted with Claude Code; second review by ChatGPT, checked)
correspondence.note: exists_ordered_prepared_continuation fixes j, Λ and T before C and gives, for every C ≥ C0, an entrance profile and continuation with PreparedBounds at the requested jet order; Assembly.certificate gives the relaxed cone on (X_a, active right end), the true cone on an initial collar 0 < log(X/X_a) ≤ t and the outgoing true cone, but only for an Assembly built (assembly_exists) from a single order-1 prepared witness, so 'every C ≥ C0' for the certified profile has to be assembled by re-running that construction with C free. X_a = 4/Λ (activeLeft) and X_R = 110(CP*)^10 (matchingRadius) are definitions. Not stated by the cited declarations for this profile: v_s(X_a, η) > 2 + c_ex at the inner endpoint, that the profiles solve (4.13) with T0 = 0 for 0 ≤ X ≤ X_a, and the factorization (4.33) with |T0| ≥ c e^{−t1²/y_a²} for this profile's T0 (the edge factor and analytic tube are stated for separately built entrance/ACT objects, linked to the witness only through nominal_ACT_fields).

links.doc:
Ordered common-witness selection. The repair tolerance and requested
finite jet order are fixed before `j`; the source and endpoint scales are
fixed before `C`. Every sufficiently large `C` works. The same entrance
profile then supports every later finite control order and tolerance.

exact.text:
∀ {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ} {d : NavierStokes.NaturalAxisCoefficients.AnalyticInputs h j σ P0} (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
  (F : NavierStokes.NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) P0),
  NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j →
    ∀ {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2 * δ < NavierStokes.ReferencePath.rampLimit) {T κ : ℝ},
      0 < T →
        κ < 1 →
          have N := NavierStokes.ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ F.profile.family;
          have L := NavierStokes.StressActivation.FromReference.refLog N δ;
          have U := NavierStokes.StressActivation.FromReference.refAxial N δ;
          have I := NavierStokes.ActivationStocks.FromReference.initial N hδ hδlim P0 hP0;
          ∃ (G :
            NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.EdgeFactor (Set.Icc (-1) 1) (T ^ 2) fun (q : ℝ × ℝ) =>
              NavierStokes.ActivationCone.activatedStress h N.endpoint I L U T κ (q.2, q.1)),
            (∀ η ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1, 0 < (G.coefficient (η, 0)).1) ∧
              ∀ η ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1,
                NavierStokes.ActiveAnnulusWeight.tilt (G.coefficient (η, 0)) =
                  NavierStokes.StressActivation.referenceP2 N.endpoint L U (0, η) /
                    NavierStokes.StressActivation.referenceP1 L (0, η)
